import os, shutil, sys
from pathlib import Path
import pathlib
from heinzel.modules.system._announced import MOVED_ASIDE, ToolSnapshot
import heinzel
assert heinzel.__version__ == "0.9.53"

def make_prefix(root: Path) -> Path:
    tool = root / "tool"
    (tool / "lib/site").mkdir(parents=True)
    (tool / "lib/site/heinzel.py").write_bytes(b"version = '0.9.53'\n")
    (tool / "pyvenv.cfg").write_bytes(b"home = /usr/bin\n")
    (tool / "bin").mkdir()
    (tool / "bin/hz").symlink_to("../lib/site/heinzel.py")
    return tool

out = Path(sys.argv[1]); work = Path(sys.argv[2])
for name in ("after_take", "interrupted"):
    shutil.rmtree(work / name, ignore_errors=True)
    prefix = make_prefix(work / name)
    folder = work / name / "state"
    snap = ToolSnapshot.take(prefix, folder)
    if name == "interrupted":
        (prefix / "lib/site/heinzel.py").write_bytes(b"version = '0.9.54'\n")
        real = pathlib.Path.rename
        calls = []
        def boom(self, target):
            calls.append(1)
            if len(calls) == 4:
                raise OSError("interrupted")
            return real(self, target)
        pathlib.Path.rename = boom
        try:
            snap.recover()
        except OSError:
            pass
        finally:
            pathlib.Path.rename = real
    dest = out / name
    shutil.rmtree(dest, ignore_errors=True)
    shutil.copytree(folder, dest, symlinks=True)
    # the prefix as it was left, so a test can set it up the same way
    shutil.copytree(prefix, out / f"{name}_prefix", symlinks=True, dirs_exist_ok=True)
